original_ai_output.title_zh: 专家呼吁将清洁从业人员纳入尼日利亚疫情防控框架
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 两名卫生与清洁领域专家在接受尼日利亚通讯社采访时呼吁，将受过专业培训的清洁从业人员纳入尼日利亚的疫情防控与应对框架，以加强感染预防与控制。专家指出，清洁不当、交叉污染以及将受过培训的清洁人员排除在应急响应规划之外，可能削弱包括埃博拉在内的传染病防控工作。专家还呼吁在应急响应协调结构中为专业清洁人员提供代表席位，并保障个人防护装备和经批准的消毒剂供应。

key_facts.fact: 两名卫生与清洁领域专家呼吁将专业清洁人员纳入尼日利亚疫情防控与应对框架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Two health and hygiene experts have called for the integration of professionally trained cleaning practitioners into Nigeria’s epidemic preparedness and response framework to strengthen infection prevention and control.

key_facts.fact: 专家在阿布贾接受尼日利亚通讯社采访时发出上述呼吁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They made the call in separate interviews with the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) on Monday in Abuja.

key_facts.fact: 专家警告清洁不当和交叉污染可能削弱包括埃博拉在内的传染病防控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: inadequate cleaning practices, cross-contamination and the exclusion of trained cleaners from emergency response planning could undermine efforts to prevent the spread of infectious diseases, including Ebola.

key_facts.fact: 专家呼吁在应急响应协调结构中为受过培训的清洁专业人员提供代表席位
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He called for trained cleaning professionals to be represented in emergency response coordination structures
